_comment: THE CRAB DEFAULT'S VOICE, TABLED (cultureway phase C). The crab is the
engine's own people and carries no cultureway document, so its voice
rides beside BUNDLED_POLICIES the way its brain does - same validator,
same clamps, same loader lifecycle. Every template here is BYTE-EQUAL
to the game.js literal it tables (the literals stay in code as the
fallbacks); the tabled==literal suite scenario is the proof, so this
file can never drift from the code without a red row.
NOT TABLED, with reasons in the phase C close-out: depart lines whose
table/bed/spentup/top/regular - a template cannot express a conditional
until Layer 1) and depart dues (no DUES slot in the depart slot set).
The old refuseHire debt is RETIRED (phase E6): the two literals behind
one key split into refuseHire (the pop) and refuseHireLog (the diary
line), both tabled below, byte-equal to the code fallbacks.

diary.missedboat: MISSED THE LAST BOAT - STAYING OVER
diary.checkin: CHECKED IN - ROOM {N} AT THE DRIFTWOOD
diary.rough: NO ROOM AT THE HOTEL - SLEPT ON THE BEACH
diary.wokesand: WOKE UP ON THE SAND - NOT A GREAT NIGHT

depart.foreign: NOTHING ON THE MENU WAS QUITE MY DISH. I MADE DO.
depart.delight: FOUND MY DISH HERE, OF ALL PLACES. I'LL SAY SO AT HOME.

depart.hungry: GETTING ON THIS BOAT HUNGRIER THAN I GOT OFF IT.

depart.weary: WORN RIGHT OUT. NOWHERE IN THIS TOWN TO SIT DOWN.

depart.missed: MISSED THE LAST BOAT. THAT WASN'T THE PLAN AT ALL.
depart.mist: THE MIST CAME IN AND I NEVER DID SEE THE FAR SHORE.
depart.quiet: A DAY BY THE SEA. I'VE HAD WORSE.
